drift_tripwires.await_0: Active runway phase finishes verification and is ready to split into completed/.
drift_tripwires.rollback_minus_1: Disk files in .agents/plans/ diverge from plan_documents or legacy flat plans reappear.
drift_tripwires.halt_null: Any plan promotes unverified test counts or introduces broken relative links.

operational_rules.starting_a_new_plan: Copy the matching blueprint from ./plan-templates/, fill @created/@updated, and register it here.
operational_rules.completing_a_phase: Split verified completed deliverables into ./completed/ and keep only remaining steps in ./active/.
operational_rules.base_first_linking: Link directly to ../host/, ../identity/profiles/operator/, ../language/, and ../lineage/ instead of duplicating SSOT values.
